remarks_1999: Whitney Archive record lost. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates lost inscription, most probably recorded from Whitney Archive, "Back: O'K: 'Pink Abstraction – Lake George, 1929.' Initials and star. Label: An Am. Pl: A.S.: Pink Abstraction by Georgia O'Keeffe" [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks photograph indicates orientation upside down, orientation here based on image characteristics since Abiquiú Notebooks orientation seems to be an error. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Collection of Phoenix Art Museum, Gift of Friends of Art (1967.81)
description: A pale pink, semicircular form arches over horizontal strips of pale yellow, green, and pink. Below the abstract painting's midline, the semicircular shape appears to be reflected upside-down in rippling water, as though the image is a landscape with a lake in its center.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Phoenix Art Museum. Photo: Ken Howie
